description: DATA-VIEWS group slice: Grid, CodeEditor, DiffView, TextViewport, TerminalView, ScrollRegion. DataTable is the junie_tui table widget behind the tables and editable pages (not a DataGrid). Same stable IDs as v1/registry.json; ref_source lists reference source symbols verified present in the cited files. src/ tree is identical between ref_commit and head_commit, so cited lines hold for both. TerminalView is the showcase terminal page composition over a TextViewport (no widget of that name exists); ScrollRegion is the ScrollState model plus the scrollbar painter and ScrollPanel (no widget of that name exists).
